description: File a question as a ticket to one operator of the workspace your key is bound to. Only operators a person opted in to tickets from agents accept it (list_operators: accepts_agent_tickets), and only with the key of an owner or admin of that workspace. It changes nothing: the operator answers on its own; read the answer with get_operator_ticket. Needs operators:instruct.

client_ticket_id.description: Your own id for this request (8-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -). Retrying with the same id and the same content returns the first ticket instead of filing a second one.

name: ask_operator
title: Ask an operator
